They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all available airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? We need to book flight? The user says "arrange a flight" but also "calculate cost". They want estimated total payable amount. We might need to compute cost and maybe add insurance? Not specified. So just provide cost.

But we need to authenticate first? For get_flight_cost, no authentication needed. So we can call get_flight_cost directly. But we need to get list of airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then get first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide cost.

We don't need to book yet. So we can just compute cost. The user wants "estimated total payable amount". That is the cost returned. So we can do that.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then call get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
